Sandbox_SCKCO_BackfireMinSpeed_tooltip: Lift-off pops only trigger above this speed.
Sandbox_SCKCO_BackfireDecelDrop_tooltip: Speed lost in one ~250ms sample to count as a throttle lift-off. Lower = pops more easily on light lifts.
Sandbox_SCKCO_BackfireWearScale_tooltip: Added lift-off chance per point of engine damage. 0.25 = +25% at a destroyed engine.
Sandbox_SCKCO_BackfireSputterMinWear_too: Engine damage (0-100) required before steady-throttle sputter begins. Below this the engine never sputters. Sputter never fires while accelerating.
Sandbox_SCKCO_BackfireAmbientScale_toolt: Steady-throttle pop rate for a damaged engine. Healthy engines never sputter.
Sandbox_SCKCO_BackfireNoiseRadius_toolti: Base tiles a pop carries and draws zombies. Scales up with muffler damage: a destroyed muffler roughly doubles it.
Sandbox_SCKCO_CruiseNoiseRadius_tooltip: Max tiles a damaged exhaust draws zombies while driving, at a destroyed muffler. Scales with muffler damage. 0 disables.
Sandbox_SCKCO_CruiseNoiseMinWear_tooltip: Muffler damage (0-100) required before driving noise begins. Below this the exhaust is quiet.
Sandbox_SCKCO_StartNoiseRadius_tooltip: Tiles the engine-start noise draws zombies. Scales up with engine wear. 0 disables.
Sandbox_SCKCO_LighterMinCharge_tooltip: Battery charge (0-100) required to use the dashboard lighter.
